Reads and writes have separate pending counters but share latest-started result ownership, so a later write prevents an earlier read from publishing stale data. Retained callbacks keep their original remote target; dispatched requests are not cancelled. Read failures publish error and resolve; writes reject and publish writeError. Recognized missing metadata returns fallback data without an error. |
